design.title: Design and source code
design.body: The calculator is designed and developed by volunteers of the Collectif Conception Numérique Responsable (responsible digital design collective). Its source code is open and published on <anchor>GitHub</anchor>.

ip.title: Intellectual property and reuse
ip.code: The site's source code, texts included, is published under the MIT licence (© Collectif Conception Numérique Responsable): you may reuse it freely, keeping this notice.
ip.data: Impacts are calculated with the EcoLogits library (MPL-2.0 licence) and equivalents with ADEME's ImpactCO2 factors. This data remains the property of its authors; its sources are detailed in the <anchor>methodology</anchor>.
ip.fonts: The Inter, Fraunces and IBM Plex Mono fonts are distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
ip.brands: The names and trademarks of the AI providers mentioned (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral AI, Microsoft…) belong to their owners. The calculator is not affiliated with any of them.

results.title: Scope of the results
results.body: The results are estimates, given as ranges, for awareness and decision support. They rely on assumptions (models, number of tokens, usage frequencies) and on public data, described in the <anchor>methodology</anchor>. They are neither a regulatory emissions report nor a measurement of a provider's actual consumption. The Green IT association cannot be held liable for decisions based on them alone.

privacy.title: Personal data
privacy.none: The calculator requires no account, sets no cookie and uses no audience measurement, advertising or social network tool. All its resources, fonts included, are served by the site itself: your browser contacts no third-party service.
privacy.inputs: What you enter (providers, use cases, frequencies, headcount) is sent to the server for the calculation. It does not identify you and is neither recorded nor kept.
privacy.files: The export file is created by your browser, directly on your device: it is not sent to the server. On import, the file is read by your browser; only the inputs it holds are sent to the server to recalculate the impacts, as for inputs entered on screen, without being kept. This file contains no personal data.
privacy.storage: Two preferences are kept in your browser (local storage): the chosen language and whether you have already taken the guided tour. They stay on your device, are never sent, and are deleted with the site's data in your browser. Needed for the service you ask for, they do not require consent.
privacy.logs: Like any web server, the server records technical logs: IP address, date and time, requested resource and browser type. They are used only for the security and proper operation of the site (legitimate interest of the association), are only accessible to the server's administrators, and are deleted automatically after a limited period. They are hosted in Switzerland, a country recognised by the European Commission as providing an adequate level of protection.
privacy.rights: The data controller is the Green IT association. You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object, which you can exercise through <anchor>the association's contact form</anchor>. You may also lodge a complaint with the <cnil>CNIL</cnil>, the French data protection authority.

links.title: External links
links.body: The site links to other sites (ImpactCO2, EcoLogits, GitHub…). Their content and data practices are the responsibility of their publishers.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.privacy: For a question about your data or this notice: <anchor>the association's contact form</anchor>.
contact.issues: To report an error or suggest an improvement to the calculator: <anchor>the project's issues on GitHub</anchor>. These exchanges are public: do not include personal data.
